title: Canonical Adoption Signal Schema
description: The single event schema for all CallLint adoption signals. Replaces 'single event pipeline' with a measurable contract: one schema, one ingestion path, zero semantic drift. This is the ONLY shape the usage-worker accepts at POST /v1/events/usage.

schema.description: Version anchor. The worker rejects batches with unknown schemas.

batchId.description: Content-derived idempotency key (SHA-256 hex digest over serialized event fingerprints). Prevents double-counting on retry.

events.description: Event list. Hard cap 100 per batch (MAX_EVENTS_PER_BATCH).

eventName.description: Event type from ALLOWED_EVENTS vocabulary. Adoption signals: install_completed, preflight_completed.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Normalized to whole seconds (no milliseconds). Year must be 2024-2100.

productVersion.description: CallLint CLI semver (e.g. '0.1.0'). Must match SAFE_TOKEN_PATTERN.

anonymousInstallationId.description: Client-generated UUID with 'cli-anon-' prefix. HMAC'd at ingestion, never stored raw (new18 §20).

hostFamily.description: Agent harness family (e.g. 'cursor', 'claude-code', 'none'). Safe token, open-ended.

inputKind.description: What was scanned (e.g. 'cursor-mcp-config', 'inline', 'npm'). Safe token, open-ended.

discoverySurface.description: Where the config was discovered. Enum-checked, NOT token-checked (new19 §21).
